mainEntity.name: What are some popular high-end appliance brands for luxury kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular high-end appliance brands for luxury kitchens often include Sub-Zero, Wolf, Miele, Thermador, and Viking, known for their performance, durability, and integrated designs. These brands offer professional-grade ranges, built-in refrigerators, wine coolers, and advanced dishwashers that combine sophisticated aesthetics with cutting-edge technology. When selecting appliances, consider your cooking habits and desired features, such as induction cooktops, steam ovens, or integrated coffee systems. The choice of appliances significantly impacts both the functionality and the overall aesthetic of a luxury kitchen.
